mapper.sql: (SELECT ad.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchase_order_detail_id, sum(ad.arrival_qty) - COALESCE((SELECT sum(fd.fail_qty) FROM tb_material_inspection_dt fd JOIN tb_material_inspection_hd ih ON ih.material_inspection_id = fd.material_inspection_id AND ih.tenant_id = fd.tenant_id WHERE fd.purchase_order_detail_id = ad.purchase_order_detail_id AND ih.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ih.use_at = 'Y'), 0) AS arrived_qty FROM tb_material_arrival_dt ad JOIN tb_material_arrival_hd ah ON ah.material_arrival_id = ad.material_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id WHERE ah.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ah.use_at = 'Y' GROUP BY ad.purchase_order_detail_id)

SELECT od.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, oh.order_dt AS orderDt, oh.tax_type AS taxType, oh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, oh.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, od.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, m.material_type_code AS materialTypeCode, od.inspect_at AS inspectAt, od.order_qty AS orderQty, COALESCE(a.arrived_qty, 0) AS arrivedQty, od.order_qty - COALESCE(a.arrived_qty, 0) AS remainQty, od.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, od.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, od.unit_price AS unitPrice, oh.currency_code AS currencyCode, oci.item_nm AS orderTypeName, uci.item_nm AS useTypeName, od.remark AS remark FROM tb_purchase_order_dt od JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.purchase_order_detail_id = od.purchase_order_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = od.material_id AND m.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = oh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = od.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = od.order_type LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ucg ON ucg.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ucg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item uci ON uci.group_id = ucg.common_code_group_id AND uci.item_code = od.use_type WHERE od.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oh.use_at = 'Y' AND od.receipt_close_at = 'N' AND od.order_qty - COALESCE(a.arrived_qty, 0) > 0
AND oh.order_dt >= CAST(#{fromDt} AS date)
AND oh.order_dt <= CAST(#{toDt} AS date)
AND (oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY c.customer_name, oh.order_dt DESC, oh.order_no, od.line_no LIMIT 500

SELECT od.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, od.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, oh.use_at AS orderUseAt, oh.supplier_id AS supplierId, oh.currency_code AS currencyCode, od.material_id AS materialId, od.order_qty AS orderQty, COALESCE((SELECT sum(ad.arrival_qty) FROM tb_material_arrival_dt ad JOIN tb_material_arrival_hd ah ON ah.material_arrival_id = ad.material_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id WHERE ad.purchase_order_detail_id = od.purchase_order_detail_id AND ah.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ah.use_at = 'Y'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT sum(fd.fail_qty) FROM tb_material_inspection_dt fd JOIN tb_material_inspection_hd ih ON ih.material_inspection_id = fd.material_inspection_id AND ih.tenant_id = fd.tenant_id WHERE fd.purchase_order_detail_id = od.purchase_order_detail_id AND ih.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ih.use_at = 'Y'), 0) AS arrivedQty, od.unit_price AS unitPrice, od.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, od.inspect_at AS inspectAt, od.receipt_close_at AS receiptCloseAt FROM tb_purchase_order_dt od JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id WHERE od.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND od.purchase_order_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY od.purchase_order_detail_id
FOR UPDATE OF od

INSERT INTO tb_material_arrival_hd ( tenant_id, arrival_no, arrival_dt, supplier_id, receiver_id, receiver_dept_id, currency_code, tax_type, vat_included_at, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, remark, created_by ) SELECT t.tenant_id, #{arrivalNo}, CAST(#{arrivalDt} AS date), #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{receiverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{receiverDeptId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{currencyCode}, #{taxType}, #{vatIncludedAt}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} RETURNING material_arrival_id

INSERT INTO tb_material_arrival_dt ( material_arrival_id, tenant_id, line_no, purchase_order_detail_id, material_id, arrival_qty, unit_price, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, warehouse_id, manufacture_dt, expire_dt, lot_no, inspect_at, remark, created_by ) VALUES ( #{materialArrivalId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineNo}, #{purchaseOrderDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{arrivalQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{manufactureDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), CAST(#{expireDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), #{lotNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inspectAt}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} ) RETURNING material_arrival_detail_id

SELECT ah.material_arrival_id AS materialArrivalId, ah.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ah.arrival_dt AS arrivalDt, ah.supplier_id AS supplierId, ah.currency_code AS currencyCode, ah.tax_type AS taxType, ah.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, ah.use_at AS useAt FROM tb_material_arrival_hd ah WHERE ah.material_arrival_id = #{materialArrivalId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ah.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE OF ah
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_material_arrival_hd SET arrival_dt = CAST(#{arrivalDt} AS date), tax_type = #{taxType}, vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE material_arrival_id = #{materialArrivalId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_material_arrival_dt SET line_no = #{lineNo}, arrival_qty = #{arrivalQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, unit_price = #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, manufacture_dt = CAST(#{manufactureDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), expire_dt = CAST(#{expireDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE material_arrival_detail_id = #{materialArrivalDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND material_arrival_id = #{materialArrivalId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE tb_material_arrival_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE material_arrival_id = #{materialArrivalId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
